description: Start here, once per business. Creates the trade's invoice book and returns an API key to send as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" on every other call. Test mode: free, nothing is charged. The same identity (company number) can later sign the trade into Nero Work without a new sign up.

company_number.description: Companies House number, if a limited company. Leave out for a sole trader.

job_reference_prefixes.description: Letters the trade puts before job numbers on orders, for example ["JOB", "HAUS"]. Default JOB, NW, REF.

job_reference_style.description: "number" (recommended when jobs are numbered): JOB-1042, Job 1042 and 1042 are all job 1042. "prefixed": keep JOB-1042 as written.

name.description: Trading name, for example Spark & Sons Electrical Ltd.

vat_registered.description: Default true. If false, bills are entered gross with no VAT.

name: create_trade_account
title: Create the business invoice book
